rules.modes: TOTAL where a unit has it, otherwise the sum of its modes; never both
rules.denominator: votes cast for a candidate (every candidate and write-in)
rules.metro: votes summed over the metro's counties (OMB 23-01), then divided once
rules.missing_county: the metro is Not available, never an undercount
